d1.title: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential and ROS Generation
d1.body: Hyperpolarization of the inner membrane (Ψm > 150 mV) increases electron leakage at Complex I and III, accelerating intracellular oxidative stress.

d2.title: mTOR–Autophagy Bistability Under Nutrient Deprivation
d2.body: Prolonged fasting suppresses mTORC1 and activates ULK1, flipping the cell into a sustained autophagic state with hysteresis on refeeding.

d3.title: Helfrich Bending Energy of Lipid Bilayers
d3.body: Membrane shape follows minimization of mean and Gaussian curvature energy; oxidative lipid damage shifts spontaneous curvature and stiffness.

d4.title: Zone 2 Training and Mitochondrial Biogenesis
d4.body: Sustained low-intensity aerobic work upregulates PGC-1α, increasing mitochondrial density and fat oxidation capacity.

d5.title: ATP Flux and Proton-Motive Force Coupling
d5.body: ATP synthase throughput scales with proton gradient; uncoupling lowers Ψm and reduces ROS at the cost of energy efficiency.

d6.title: Geometric Clustering of Aging Biomarkers
d6.body: Normalized multi-omic biomarker vectors cluster on the hypersphere into distinct longevity phenotypes missed by linear reference ranges.
